title: Very excited to share the first concept trailer of our AI game "Echo of Mobius"!
author: echo_of_mobius

comments.author: echo_of_mobius
comments.body:
**Echo of Mobius is a game born from people's wildest dreams.**

By using our AI models, we enable players to create and share ANY game characters and adventure events. Join us to turn your fantasies into companions and explore creations from others.

>

Our demo is dropping soon, and we’ll be part of the Steam Next Fest!

replies.author: Key_Extension_6003
replies.body: Is the idea that you use your local GPU to generate the images?

replies.author: echo_of_mobius
replies.body: No, sadly it’s still beyond local GPU’s ability. So you have to have internet access to play this game

replies.author: Key_Extension_6003
replies.body: So is subscription based on Steam?

replies.author: echo_of_mobius
replies.body: somehow yes. The price of the game covers some AI usage but for further AI generations players can buy credits

replies.author: Key_Extension_6003
replies.body: Ah ok. Kind of feel that steams business model should support subscription but I guess if you can buy credits it's a fair workaround.

comments.author: DoctaRoboto
comments.body: The concept is great but I recommend you add some word filters to prevent the model from generating certain characters if you don't want to be sued into deep space. Nintendo is the kind of greedy disgusting company that will sue you for having sewer pipes in your game, the moment they know that you can generate characters like Mario or Pikachu in a non-Nintendo game you'll wish you were dead my friend. And we are talking only about one of the biggest offenders, then we have Disney, Warner, and hundreds of celebrities...not a good look in my opinion.
